description: This Java source file defines the FragmentStackFragment class, which manages a stack of fragments within an Android application. It handles fragment creation, addition, removal, and state persistence across configuration changes.

classes.name: FragmentStackFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that manages a stack of child fragments, allowing adding new fragments to the stack and popping fragments off the back stack.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, adding an initial child fragment if there is no saved state.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout and sets up click listeners for buttons to add or remove fragments.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current stack level state.

methods.name: addFragmentToStack
methods.description: Adds a new fragment to the stack and updates the UI accordingly.
